svg.title: Equipotentials of −4q and +q
svg.desc: Computed equipotentials of a charge q1 = −4q on the left and q2 = +q a distance d to its right. The zero-potential equipotential, drawn heavier, is a circle around the smaller positive charge: it crosses the line between the charges one fifth of the way from q2 to q1, and crosses the axis again d/3 beyond q2; its radius is 4d/15. Inside it, positive equipotentials are small loops around q2. Outside it, the potential is negative: small loops surround q1 closely, and farther out closed curves enclose both charges and the zero circle. No equipotential connects the two charges. Faint field lines run from q2 to q1 and in toward q1 from far away. The potential increases toward q2 and away from q1.
